{{Quote|Who braves the flames of the Altar of Horror to stand in front of Lord Barel-Slathborn, Lord of the Sith?|Commander Gargun, possessed by Barel-Slathborn's spirit|<ref name="SWTOR" />}}
'''Barel-Slathborn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the old [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] who was among the first inhabitants of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. After his [[Death/Legends|death]], Barel-Slathborn's [[Force ghost/Legends|spirit]] was trapped within the [[Dark Temple]], and it possessed [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Gargun]] when the man entered the temple.<ref name="SWTOR" />
